headline: Ukrainian Drone Hits and Satellite Data Indicate Fires at Russian Refineries
summary: Ukraine struck three Russian refineries since Friday, with satellite data indicating a fresh heat anomaly and fire at a major Samara region crude oil pumping station.
why: Attacks on Russian energy infrastructure can disrupt petroleum product supply chains and influence global crude and refined product pricing dynamics.
why_moved: Attacks on key crude infrastructure directly threaten supply availability from a major global oil exporter, sparking immediate supply-risk concerns in energy markets.
